description:
A compliance manager needs to update the organization's risk appetite configuration in Eramba following a board-level risk governance review. The board has decided to lower risk tolerance from Medium (level 3) to Low (level 2) across all risk domains.

Update the risk appetite settings for ALL THREE risk domains:
1. Enterprise Risks (Risks) — change risk appetite from 3 to 2
2. Third Party Risks (ThirdPartyRisks) — change risk appetite from 3 to 2
3. Business Continuity Risks (BusinessContinuities) — change risk appetite from 3 to 2

IMPORTANT:
- Do NOT change the risk appetite method (keep it as the current simple threshold mode, value 0)
- Do NOT change the risk calculation method (keep it as 'eramba')
- All three domains must be updated
- Navigate to the Risk Management settings/configuration area in Eramba to make these changes. This is typically found under System Settings or the Administration section, then the Risk Management configuration.

Eramba URL: http://localhost:8080
Login: admin / Admin2024!

The current risk appetite for all three domains is set to 3. You need to change all three to 2.
